items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: we had a lot of the old reissues of the Johnny Dodds and King Olivers and the blues singers and Tommy Ladner and all that sort of stuff that they reissued.

ctx.x: Yeah, we're going again. Okay. Trying to do too much at once. So we were talking about the London reissues.

Yeah, that's right. Yes, well, as I said, I met Jeff Holden and a few other friends that I used to play tennis with, and I'd known some of them from around the district. The district? Around our district. Well, around our district. Oh, our district. Unfortunately, not this district. Oh, we'd be playing different music. Anyway, he invited me over to his place because I was interested in a bit of jazz, and he played me a few records, and we used to then listen to records regularly. Every second day we'd be…
And that white New Orleans. Oh, well, he had bits and pieces, yeah.
